question.text: Which of the following products is NOT covered under the interoperability framework?

explanation.text: The Logic: Commodity derivatives and Tri-party repo are excluded from the interoperability framework. Also excluded are IFSC clearing corporations. The Trap: Equity cash, equity derivatives, and debt segments are covered. Only commodity derivatives and tri-party repo are excluded. Cross-Exam Context: Knowing the scope and exclusions of interoperability is testable.
